mapper.select: SELECT RATE_ID as rateId, CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, CURRENCY_NAME as currencyName, RATE_TYPE as rateType, EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, RATE_DATE as rateDate, IS_BASE_CURRENCY as isBaseCurrency, IS_ENABLED as isEnabled, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_CURRENCY_RATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY RATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT RATE_ID as rateId, CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, CURRENCY_NAME as currencyName, RATE_TYPE as rateType, EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, RATE_DATE as rateDate, IS_BASE_CURRENCY as isBaseCurrency, IS_ENABLED as isEnabled, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_CURRENCY_RATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND CURRENCY_CODE = #{currencyCode} AND RATE_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY RATE_DATE DESC

SELECT DISTINCT CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, CURRENCY_NAME as currencyName, IS_BASE_CURRENCY as isBaseCurrency FROM T_CURRENCY_RATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY IS_BASE_CURRENCY DESC, CURRENCY_CODE ASC

SELECT RATE_ID as rateId, CURRENCY_CODE as currencyCode, CURRENCY_NAME as currencyName, RATE_TYPE as rateType, EXCHANGE_RATE as exchangeRate, RATE_DATE as rateDate, IS_BASE_CURRENCY as isBaseCurrency, IS_ENABLED as isEnabled, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM T_CURRENCY_RATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_BASE_CURRENCY = 1 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} ORDER BY RATE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT CURRENCY_CODE FROM T_CURRENCY_RATE WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY CURRENCY_CODE ASC
